<<<2525a57c-2006-429e-8455-bbb6a7e9212a>>> — Environment ref from uploaded image. Brutalist circular concrete atrium, curved smooth concrete walls, large rectangular clerestory windows high above letting in cold flat grey daylight, thick concrete columns rising from the floor, polished grey concrete floor scattered with debris, broken glass — bare dead trees near the walls, extremely dark and cold atmosphere. Environment only.

<<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> — 350cm tall demon, reddish-brown cracked deeply veined skin, long black greasy hair, skeletal grinning face, yellow teeth, green-yellow eyes, bone spikes on shoulders and spine, oversized muscular arms, torn loincloth, clawed feet. Right arm ref strictly from uploaded image: the forearm is reddish-brown cracked and veined skin with sparse dark coarse hair — at the wrist the clawed fingers of the hand curl tightly around the base of two long diverging ivory-pale bone extensions, the fingers gripping the bone junction where they emerge — one bone extension angling upward and one angling downward — both bone surfaces yellowed and mottled, smooth and tapering to sharp points — the hand and bone are one unified structure, the fingers permanently fused around the bone base. Cunning and intelligent. Creature appearance only.

Scene context: <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> winding up its right arm to strike. Only <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> in frame — no other characters visible anywhere in the shot. Slow motion.

8K IMAX ultra-detailed. 16mm Kodak 500T. Heavy grain. Hyper-realistic. No cloning. Only <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> in frame. Columns strictly vertical. Medium close-up only. Camera always moving. Slow motion throughout. Hollywood acting. Strictly natural light only — cold gray daylight falling from above — light atmospheric haze fills the air — dust particles float within the light.

CUT — medium close-up <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> alone in frame, slow motion — camera at mid-height shooting straight at <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>>'s torso and right arm — only <<<5502264c-e9c6-438c-bd4b-5b2f84fb1d9c>>> visible, no other characters — the upper body and right arm filling the frame in a grounded close-up, the creature's proportions natural and physical rather than overwhelming — the right arm drawing back in slow motion, the clawed fingers gripping the bone junction tightly, the two diverging ivory-pale bone extensions rising as the arm pulls backward — the entire right arm winding up, the full weight of the creature loading behind it — the bone extensions catching cold grey light from above, the yellowed ivory surface visible in detail — the slow motion amplifying every detail of the wind-up — the atrium cold and dark in the background —

Photoreal. NON-IP. 16:9. 10s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.

<<<7c7ea71a-bcc1-44fe-8fb2-a09e3a16d444>>> [image1] - 20yo male, lean athletic build. Long messy black hair to shoulders. Thin mustache. Red cloth bandage diagonally across the bridge of his nose. Dark brown eyes, intense and focused. Pale skin, dark circles, thin scratches on cheek. Tight black short-sleeve tactical t-shirt (darker at shoulders/chest from melted snow). Dark olive-black tactical cargo pants with thigh holster rig. Red bandana on right wrist. Black fingerless gloves. Worn brown combat boots. Small red toy-bear keychain on right hip. His RIGHT forearm and hand are translucent deep blood-red crystal - raw geode, faceted, internal crimson glow. Two faint crimson veins glow under the skin of his chest through his shirt. Visible breath vapor. Snow accumulates on hair and shoulders. Character appearance only.
<<<e396547e-df91-4ae5-b2b7-b730eb86f7b3>>> [image14] - Translucent deep blood-red crystal sword, ~1m long (extends to katana size when wielded by the Crystal Knight). Raw geode, faceted, jagged crystalline edge, internal crimson glow. Hilt fused directly to wielder's right crystal hand - no separate handle, crystal flows up from the wrist. Same material as Roco's crystal forearm and the Crystal Knight armor. Element reference only.
<<<3e86e59e-2112-4cc0-aaca-a9b275551f69>>> [image15] - Roco in his Crystal Knight form: a 2.2m colossus encased in jagged translucent blood-red crystal armor, faceted like rough rose quartz, internally glowing crimson. NO HELMET - his head is FULLY EXPOSED and his face is clearly visible at all times (no visor, no faceplate, no helmet of any kind, head sticks out from the top of the high crystal collar). His face is Roco's face: same intense brown eyes, same messy dark-brown/black hair (often slightly wet/messy from the storm and sweat, falling across his forehead), same pale skin with dark circles under the eyes from exhaustion, same red diagonal bandage on the bridge of his nose, same faint stubble/light moustache, same thin scratches and minor cuts on his cheek and forehead. His face is fully readable - emotions, jaw clenches, tears, breath, all visible. His neck is partly visible above the high crystal collar.

The crystal armor itself: A wide HIGH CRYSTAL COLLAR rising up from the shoulders to the base of his jaw (like a turtleneck made of small jagged red crystals tightly packed) - it protects his throat but does NOT cover his face. Massive WING-LIKE FANS of long jagged crystal spikes burst sideways from each shoulder pauldron - asymmetric clusters of long pointed crystals (some spikes 60-80cm long) extending outward and slightly back from the shoulders like crystalline wings. Chest plate of overlapping faceted crystal segments. Crystal vambrace / forearm armor in ridged faceted segments. Crystal gauntlets with faceted crystal plating on the back of the hands and tipped with small clawed crystal extensions on the fingertips - but the gauntlets allow finger articulation (he can grip, hold, point, gesture - the fingers move). Crystal greaves on legs in faceted segments. Crystal-armored boots. The whole armor is the same translucent blood-red rough-quartz material with internal crimson glow visible through the crystal. Same material as the crystal sword in his right hand. Some smaller jagged crystal spikes growing along the spine and lower back.

<<<3e86e59e-2112-4cc0-aaca-a9b275551f69>>> is in his Crystal Knight form by default. The armor is his DEFAULT STATE throughout this entire sequence. However, in specific dramatic emotional moments, the armor may PARTIALLY recede or dissolve as described in each shot's Scene context (for example: a single gauntlet retracting to expose a bare hand, the chest scales partly opening to reveal his t-shirt, or in some moments the armor receding completely leaving him in his black tactical combat clothes). When NOT specifically described as receding in a shot's Scene context, he is in FULL CRYSTAL ARMOR. Each shot's body text is authoritative: follow the Scene context and CUTs of that shot for whether his armor is full, partial, or fully receded.

Underneath the crystal armor, when it does recede, he wears: a worn dirty BLACK TACTICAL T-SHIRT, dark TACTICAL PANTS, and combat BOOTS. His arms beneath the gauntlets are pale-skinned, lean, with thin scratches and old scars. His left palm has a fresh diagonal cut wound (made earlier with a tactical combat knife) bleeding bright red. His right hand is bloodied from holding the small red crystal teardrop. His face is the same throughout - intense brown eyes, messy dark-brown hair, pale skin with dark circles, red diagonal bandage on the bridge of his nose, faint moustache and stubble.

Character appearance only.
 [image9] - Faceless warriors in black-lacquered samurai armor with smooth featureless iron masks (no eye-holes, no mouth-slits). Tall, lean build (~1.8m tall, slim shoulders). Each carries a katana sheathed at the right hip. They emerge from the snow (snow fractures, black-gauntleted hands push up). When killed they dissolve into black sand and the empty armor husks collapse a beat later. Snow accumulates on helmets, shoulders, and sheaths; white frost rims their iron masks. Environment/horde only.
 [image17] - Heavier warrior class. Black-lacquered samurai armor with HORNED helmet (two short curved iron horns rising from the temples), oni-style demon mask with a permanent grimace and slightly visible iron teeth, slightly larger pauldrons with gold trim accents. Bulkier broader build (~1.9m tall, wider shoulders, thicker torso). Each carries a longer katana (or odachi) sheathed at the right hip - slightly larger blade than the. They move with heavier weighted gait. When killed they dissolve into black sand same as. Snow accumulates on horns, helmets, shoulders, and sheaths. Environment/horde only - should appear MIXED with throughout the army, not in their own group, just scattered through the crowd to add visual variety.
 [image18] - Lighter scout class. Dark-grey lacquered armor (lighter than ' pure black), with a smaller fitted iron mask covering only the lower face (chin, nose, cheeks) leaving the upper head exposed - a top-knot of black hair with a wrapped white headband (hachimaki) tied around the forehead, dark hollow eye sockets visible. Leaner faster build (~1.7m, athletic). Each carries a shorter katana (wakizashi) sheathed at the right hip and sometimes a small tanto at the small of the back. They move quicker, lighter steps. When killed they dissolve into black sand same as the others. Snow accumulates on the headband, shoulders, and sheaths. Environment/horde only - should appear MIXED with and throughout the army, scattered through the crowd to add visual variety.
4 [image19] - Ashigaru foot-soldier class. Mismatched, weathered, rougher armor: simpler dark-brown and black laminated armor pieces with visible repair patches and gold-tarnished plates, a wide-brimmed iron jingasa hat (low conical iron cap covering the head and shading the face), a half-mask covering only the lower face leaving the eyes shadowed under the hat brim. Average build (~1.75m), worn appearance like long-serving foot soldiers. Each carries a yari (short spear, ~1.6m haft with iron blade tip) instead of a katana - held in both hands when ready, or slung over the shoulder. Some carry a katana at the hip as backup. They move in disciplined waves. When killed they dissolve into black sand same as the others. Snow accumulates on the jingasa hat brims, shoulders, spear shafts. Environment/horde only - should appear MIXED with,, throughout the army, scattered to add visual variety.
@wasteland [image10 - element reference only, do not copy framing - TWO sides: FRONT and BACK] - Isolated snow-covered Japanese plain in the middle of nowhere, surrounded on every side by suffocating thick white-grey fog. NO HORIZON visible. NO mountains. NO Mt Fuji. NO distant landmarks of any kind. The fog is so dense it eats everything past ~40-60m into pure white-grey nothing - a wall of mist closing the world off from every direction. Beyond that wall: only featureless pale grey-white void. The sky merges seamlessly with the fog so there is no defined horizon line anywhere. Heavy dark storm clouds visible only at the very top of the sky, fading downward into the fog wall. No sun, no warm light, no rim light. The location feels like a small isolated clearing trapped inside infinite fog, like the eye of a snowstorm. Heavy snow falls steadily through the fog. The location has TWO distinct sides:
FRONT SIDE (the tree side, where <<<b091d5b1-2a35-4f43-859e-f359ea665e5f>>> stands): One living Japanese tree at center of this side, ~8m tall - gnarled silver-grey trunk with exposed roots gripping a small mossy mound, broad low canopy of small leaves in deep crimson and frost-white (snow-covered momiji or sakura, low and bonsai-like). The tree sits on a slight rise of mossy grey rock outcrops half-buried in snow. Around the base of the tree: scattered fallen red leaves on the snow, small dome-shaped red-leaf shrubs with crimson tiny leaves, small red flowering sprigs, dry susuki grass tufts with puffy beige seed-heads, more mossy grey rock outcrops with snow on top. To the left and right of the tree: more rocky outcrops with red shrubs and susuki grass scattered through them. The tree is the ONLY distant landmark visible from anywhere in this clearing - everything else past 40-60m is pure fog.
BACK SIDE (the empty side, behind <<<7c7ea71a-bcc1-44fe-8fb2-a09e3a16d444>>> when he faces the tree): A flat-to-rolling expanse of pure white snow with a few low rocky outcrops scattered around, small red-leaf shrub patches and dry susuki grass tufts, fallen red leaves in patches - but NO TREE on this side, no major landmark, just smaller scattered ground details. Beyond ~40-60m the BACK side dissolves into the same white-grey fog wall. Looking from the FRONT (tree) side toward the BACK side: you see Roco's back/shoulders in foreground and beyond him just the empty plain dissolving into fog. Looking from the BACK side toward the FRONT side: you see the lone Japanese tree in middle distance with Monster at its base.
Plain is NEVER flat or empty in any direction - both sides have rich Japanese ground texture (susuki grass tufts, red-leaf shrubs, red sprigs, mossy rocks, fallen red leaves) - but only the FRONT side has the tree. Environment only.

STYLE PREFIX: Ground detail: The snow plain is NEVER flat or empty. Foreground/middle-ground MUST always show abundant Japanese ground texture: tall dry susuki grass tufts with puffy beige seed-heads (multiple clusters in lower frame), small dome-shaped red-leaf shrubs with crimson tiny leaves poking through snowdrifts, small red flowering sprigs in patches (crimson blossoms peeking out), patches of mossy grey rock outcrops with snow on top, scattered fallen red leaves drifting in clusters across the snow. Ground rolls in uneven drift waves with visible undulation. Reference image of the location is for STYLE/ELEMENT reference only - do NOT copy the close-up framing of the reference image. The tree is always a DISTANT landmark, never large or center-frame unless directed by the GEOMETRY block.
Scene context: Samurai strikes Crystal Knight in chest with two-handed overhead chop. Katana BOUNCES off armor. Knight grabs samurai by throat. Spikes extrude inside the gauntlet from palm - black sand pours through his closed grip.
STRICT: <<<7c7ea71a-bcc1-44fe-8fb2-a09e3a16d444>>> (Crystal Knight) and ONE @samurai. Strike CLEAN AND HARD but katana bounces off as if hitting solid stone. Knight does not tilt or blink. Spikes are INSIDE the closed gauntlet, visible through translucent crystal.
KNIGHT DESIGN: See <<<f775efc1-8818-481f-8c21-cd7884caebe7>>> [image15] tag in header for the full visual reference of the Crystal Knight armor. In this shot <<<7c7ea71a-bcc1-44fe-8fb2-a09e3a16d444>>> appears as / is the Crystal Knight form (2.2m tall, jagged translucent blood-red crystal armor with helmet spike, shoulder spike fans, chest scales, spiked gauntlets - all per [image15] reference). ARMY DIVERSITY: The samurai army is NOT uniform - NOT clones of one design. It is a mixed force of FOUR DIFFERENT WARRIOR CLASSES blended throughout the entire crowd: (standard black-lacquered iron-mask warriors with katanas, ~60% of the army), (heavier horned-helmet oni-mask warriors with odachi, ~15% of the army), (lighter scouts with white headbands, partial face masks, and shorter blades, ~15% of the army), 4 (rougher ashigaru foot soldiers with jingasa iron hats and yari spears, ~10% of the army). All FOUR variants appear MIXED together throughout the crowd - never in their own separate groups, never lined up by type, but scattered randomly through the army at all distances and angles. Adjacent samurai in any frame should often be DIFFERENT variants. The visual feel: a real medieval Japanese army assembled from many units, NOT a uniform copy-pasted horde. They all share the same color palette (dark blacks, dark browns, iron-grey, with occasional gold-tarnish accents) so the army still reads as a unified threat - but the silhouettes, helmets, masks, weapons, and builds are visibly varied. SPATIAL ANCHOR - FRONT/BACK SIDES: The location has two distinct sides separated by Roco's position. The FRONT SIDE is where <<<b091d5b1-2a35-4f43-859e-f359ea665e5f>>> stands (at the base of the lone Japanese tree, with rocky outcrops and red shrubs around the tree). The BACK SIDE is the empty fog-walled plain that lies BEHIND Roco when he faces the tree - no tree on this side, just snow, scattered low rocks, small shrubs, and the same fog wall closing it off ~40-60m out. <<<7c7ea71a-bcc1-44fe-8fb2-a09e3a16d444>>> stands 10 meters from the tree, FACING the tree (= facing toward Monster on the FRONT side, = his back is turned to the BACK side / empty side). Camera framing rules: when the camera looks "forward toward the tree" (over Roco's shoulder, or from the BACK side toward the FRONT side), the tree and Monster are visible in middle/deep background. When the camera looks "backward away from the tree" (over Monster's shoulder, or from the FRONT side toward the BACK side), the empty BACK plain is visible behind Roco - no tree, only fog and scattered ground details. NEVER show the tree on Roco's back side (the BACK plain is always treeless). NEVER show empty plain behind Monster (Monster is always at the tree on the FRONT side). STORM ESCALATION (starting from 66.5 onward, applies to this shot): The weather has escalated dramatically - what was heavy snowfall in earlier shots has become a full BLIZZARD with three intensified factors: (1) FIERCE WIND blowing horizontally across the plain - strong enough to drag snow sideways through the air, blow Roco's hair and clothing horizontally, whip the samurais' helmet ties and armor cords sideways, bend the susuki grass tufts low to the ground in the wind direction, push the tree's canopy and flying leaves horizontally; the wind is felt physically in every frame - characters lean slightly into it, hair and fabric whip horizontally, dust and snow particles streak across the lens at high speed. (2) SNOWSTORM / BLIZZARD - instead of soft falling snowflakes, the snow is now driven hard and FAST through the frame at sharp horizontal/diagonal angles by the wind, forming visible streaks across the camera lens, hitting characters and armor from one side, accumulating heavily on shoulders and one cheek of the face on the windward side. The snow density is so heavy that visibility is reduced even more than before. (3) DENSER FOG - the fog wall closes in even tighter than baseline (~30-40m visibility now instead of 40-60m), the air feels thick with moisture, distant figures (samurai in deeper rings, the tree, Monster at the tree) become hazier and more ghost-like in the dense mist mixed with driven snow. The combined effect is a violent winter storm - the world feels hostile, oppressive, alive with motion. NOTE: This storm is consistent with the established cold grey-blue palette and overcast diffused lighting - NO sun, NO warm tones, NO directional light cutting through; just dim cold storm light, dark grey clouds at the very top of frame fading down into the white-grey wall of driven snow and fog.
GEOMETRY: <<<7c7ea71a-bcc1-44fe-8fb2-a09e3a16d444>>> (Crystal Knight) at frame-center, body facing camera-front. ONE @samurai at frame-right of Knight, mid-charge, two-handed katana strike at Knight's chest. Knight's left clawed gauntlet wraps samurai's neck (frame-right). Living Japanese tree deep background. pure white-grey fog wall far background. Foreground/middle-ground MUST contain visible organic details - the camera frame is NEVER allowed to show only flat empty snow. ALWAYS visible in the foreground area of the frame: tufts of tall dry susuki grass with puffy beige seed-heads bending in the snow (multiple clusters, prominent in lower frame), small dome-shaped red-leaf shrubs with crimson tiny leaves poking through the snowdrifts (multiple scattered through foreground/middle ground), small red flowering sprigs in patches (clusters of crimson blossoms peeking out of the white surface), patches of mossy grey rock outcrops with snow on top, scattered fallen red leaves drifting in clusters across the snow surface. Ground rolls in uneven drift waves with visible undulation, NOT a smooth flat sheet. The plain MUST look textured, alive, and Japanese - NOT a generic blank white field. Heavy atmospheric fog blurs everything beyond ~50m into pale grey wash, horizon completely lost in mist.

CUT - medium 35mm - @samurai sprints at <<<7c7ea71a-bcc1-44fe-8fb2-a09e3a16d444>>>. Two-handed downward strike with katana to Knight's chest plate.
CUT - extreme close-up 85mm - katana hits chest plate. BOUNCES OFF. Blade vibrates. Sharp ring like steel on stone.
CUT - close-up 50mm - Knight does not tilt. Does not blink. Reaches forward with left clawed gauntlet.
CUT - medium 35mm - Knight's left clawed gauntlet wraps around samurai's neck. LIFTS samurai off snow. Feet dangling.
CUT - extreme close-up 85mm - INSIDE the closed gauntlet (visible through translucent crystal) - crystal SPIKES extrude inward from palm into samurai's neck. Iron mask cracks at throat seam.
CUT - wide 24mm - samurai DISSOLVES into BLACK SAND. Sand pours through Knight's still-closed gauntlet onto snow. Empty husk drops as Knight opens his hand.

STORM AMPLIFIER (CRITICAL - present in every frame):
INTENSE BLIZZARD: Heavy continuous snowfall driven by strong wind, multi-layered streaking flakes coming SIDEWAYS across frame. THREE LAYERS visible: foreground large flakes (8-15mm) drifting close to camera as bokeh, mid-layer medium flakes (3-6mm) sharp at character distance, deep background fine particles forming dense atmospheric haze.
THICK FOG/MIST: Heavy cold fog at multiple levels - LOW GROUND FOG hugging snow at knee height drifting and curling around character legs, MID-LEVEL FOG BANDS partially veiling distance, BACKGROUND FOG WALL swallowing deep BG (visibility cut to ~15-20m max). The horizon is GONE - snow ground fades into white-grey fog. Distant elements (fires, trees, samurai) read as diffused silhouettes through the haze.
TACTILE SNOW ON CHARACTERS: Snow ACCUMULATING in real-time on tops of heads, hair, eyelashes, shoulders, forearms, jacket chests. Wet snow STICKING to faces (patches melting on cheeks/brow leaving wet sheen). Snow CAUGHT in fabric folds. Hair becoming WET and stringy. Visible thick BREATH VAPOR plumes when lips part. Snow getting BLOWN INTO faces - characters squint and brush snow from eyes.
TACTILE SNOW ON ENVIRONMENT: Lone tree branches heavy with thick snow caps, occasional clumps cascading off branches in wind gusts. Combat debris partially BURIED in fresh snow. Footprints FILLING IN with new snowfall. Dead grass tufts caked white.
WIND VISIBLE: Snow streaking horizontally driven by wind. Loose snow LIFTING off ground in low whirls and "snow devils". Tree branches swaying visibly. Smoke columns BENT sideways. Continuous wind howl audible.
For close-ups: snowflakes ALWAYS visible drifting between camera and subject's face, several streaking past lens.
The blizzard is NOT background - it is HOSTILE, OPPRESSIVE, ACTIVELY COMING DOWN on the characters.

Photoreal. NON-IP. 16:9. 10s. SFX only. NO CGI. Cinematic.

Style: 8K IMAX. Photorealistic — no 3D render, no game engine, no game-cutscene aesthetic.
Cinematography: Emmanuel Lubezki × Roger Deakins.
Lighting: Natural light only — contre-jour backlight, camera on shadow side, atmospheric haze throughout. Key light from sky and windows only.
Color: 60:30:10 — dominant / secondary / accent.
Camera: Physical cine lens. 180° shutter motion blur.
Skin: Pore-level realism — vellus hair, asymmetric moles, capillary flush, pore-shadow matching on-set light.
Acting: Hollywood — micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, wet living eyes with catch-lights, visible breath and chest rise.
Physics: Gravity and inertia respected — mass has real weight, correct contact shadows. No floating props.
Composition: Rule of thirds + golden ratio. Every person moving from frame one.
Continuity: Characters, props, environment identical across every cut. No identity drift.
Technical: 24fps smooth motion. 8K detail. No jitter.
Audio: Environmental SFX only. No music. No subtitles.

CHARACTERS:

<<<c8ecd31c-df50-4452-b7b3-d175a74877d8>>> — Rein. Grey-silver short bob, single scar on left eye only. Grey hooded zip-front jacket with chest pockets, black turtleneck, dark cargo pants, brown belt, leg-strap pouch on the right thigh. The crew's tech genius — speaks sharp and sarcastic, uses words nobody understands, eye-rolling is her default expression. She rides a small magnetic flying board: long narrow grey deck on top, two round magnetic discs on the underside (one at the front end, one at the back end), each disc surrounded by a glowing blue ring of light. The board floats about one meter above the floor and moves fast and steady.

 — a big dim two-story stone hall inside the monastery. The main entrance is a tall wooden ARCHED double door on one wall — the same arched doorway visible in the reference image. Tall red wooden columns hold up a wooden second-floor balcony that wraps the whole room. The second floor has a low red wooden railing. Storage stuff — barrels, sacks, ladders, shelves — pushed against the side walls. Stone floor. Deep shadows fill the walls and the edges of the room. Only a small beam of cold light comes down from a small skylight in the ceiling, hitting the middle of the floor. A few tiny orange candles glow softly far in the back. Very quiet.

<<<cfa6a0ca-5d92-4808-b609-e52f0c580408>>> — warrior monks all dressed exactly the same: red hooded sleeveless tunic, red cloth mask covering the lower face up to the eyes, brown sash belt, baggy red pants, red wrapped sandals.

<<<963e557a-2619-44fb-be7c-33cf4ade0e73>>> — a hunting throwing spear with a long dark wooden shaft, a golden flat leaf-shaped blade with old carved symbols on it, and a small golden cap on the back end.

SPATIAL LAYOUT
The action takes place inside. Rein is in the middle of the ground floor, floating on her magnetic board about one meter above the stone floor, right under the small beam of cold light from the ceiling skylight. Above her runs the wooden second-floor balcony with the low red wooden railing wrapping around the whole room. Three monks are up on that second-floor balcony, hidden in deep shadow.

STRICT
